title: SWF: emit DefineScalingGrid (tag 78) for 9-slice symbols
description:
Task 0339 wired 9-slice scaling into the model and FLA round-trip but the SWF compiler never emits tag 78. DefineScalingGrid must follow the DefineSprite tag for every symbol whose scale9Grid is non-null.

Without tag 78, Ruffle applies uniform scaling and distorts corners of 9-slice symbols.

Fix: in packages/swf/src/compile.ts, after emitting DefineSprite for a symbol, check if symbol.scale9Grid != null and emit a DefineScalingGrid record (tag 78) with the four rect values (left/right/top/bottom as twips). Also add the tag constant to packages/swf/src/tags.ts if absent.

Acceptance: add a test in packages/swf/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts that compiles a document with a 9-slice symbol and parses back to assert a DefineScalingGrid tag follows its DefineSprite.
